strings.cannotopenpdf: Cannot open the PDF. The file may be corrupt, or in an unsupported format.
strings.default_help: If set, this feedback method will be enabled by default for all new assignments.
strings.editpdf_help: Annotate student submissions directly in the browser and produce an edited downloadable PDF.
strings.enabled_help: If enabled, the teacher will be able to create annotated PDF files when marking assignment submissions. This allows the teacher to add comments, drawing and stamps directly on top of the student's work. The annotating is done in the browser and no extra software is required.
strings.errorgenerateimage: Error generating image with ghostscript, debugging info: {$a}
strings.errorpdfpage: There was an error while generating this page.
strings.jsrequired: JavaScript is required to annotate a PDF. Please enable JavaScript in your browser to use this feature.
strings.partialwarning: Some of the files in this submission can only be accessed by direct download.
strings.pathtogserror: The configured path to ghostscript is not correctly set: {$a}
strings.pathtogspathdesc: Please note that annotate PDF requires the path to ghostscript to be set in {$a}.
strings.privacy:metadata:colourpurpose: Colour of the comment or annotation
strings.privacy:metadata:conversionpurpose: Files are converted to PDFs to allow for annotations.
strings.privacy:metadata:filepurpose: Stores an annotated PDF with feedback for the user.
strings.privacy:metadata:rawtextpurpose: Stores raw text for the quick data.
strings.stampsdesc: Stamps must be image files (recommended size: 40x40). These images can be used with the stamp tool to annotate the PDF.
